sentences.en: That topic is too intimate to share with casual acquaintances.
sentences.zh: 这个话题太私人了，不适合和普通朋友分享。

sentences.en: Sami was still trying to have casual conversation with Layla.
sentences.zh: 萨米还在试着和莱拉进行随便的聊天。

sentences.en: This is an error not seen by the casual observer.
sentences.zh: 这是一个普通的观察者不会注意到的错误。
